semiconductor_relevance: Medium — AICEP supports the semiconductor sector by promoting foreign investment and internationalization of Portuguese semiconductor companies.
summary: AICEP is the Portuguese Trade & Investment Agency that facilitates foreign investment and the internationalization of the Portuguese economy, with a focus on the semiconductor sector. It provides tailored solutions for semiconductor companies to navigate market entry and operational challenges, aiming to enhance their global competitiveness.
capabilities: Facilitating foreign investment in the semiconductor sector
Promoting internationalization of Portuguese semiconductor companies
Organizing promotional campaigns and events for the semiconductor industry
Providing tailored solutions for market entry and operational challenges

regional_presence.Portugal: AICEP operates through its network of offices in Portugal to support the semiconductor industry.
